newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bonds, futures firm on convergence hopes.
newsitem.headline: Italy bonds, futures firm on convergence hopes.

text.p: 0745 GMT - Italian debt markets firm in early trade close to record highs with players optimistic on European convergence and strong buying high yielders. Lira also strong vs mark. Record high on Btp future continuation chart was 132.38 in January.
* Bonds:Feb07 +28 bps at 98.55, yield 7.07 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 140 bps.
* Futures:Sep LIF +48 bps at 132.27, res 132.32 then 132.63. * Lira:981.90/2.20 per mark.
